title: Keynote statement launch
summary: Four short statements on a flat background, one every 2.6 s: eyebrow and name, two claims, then availability with the URL. Per-word blur-drop entrances and a slow scale creep keep calm type alive.
use_when: The product is announced before there is UI worth showing
A silent autoplay feed where the type has to carry the whole message
Opening or closing a longer film with three or four claims
A premium, restrained brand voice (no hype, no SFX)

look.type_style: large grotesk, bold, tight tracking (-0.02 em), 10 % of frame height, a period on every statement; small tracked mono eyebrow

structure.shot: eyebrow 'INTRODUCING' then the product name with a period, centred on flat light grey
structure.camera: push-in: statement scale 0.985 -> 1.03 across the hold, decelerating
structure.motion: eyebrow blur-in 4 fr before the name; name per word, stagger 2 fr, blur 0.12 em -> 0, drops 0.2 em, outExpo 12 fr; settled f17; exit at f87: 5 fr fade + 0.1 em drift + blur
same entrance, starts f97 after 4 empty frames; hold ~2.2 s; exit f165
same entrance at f175, metronomic 78 fr period; exit f243

structure.shot: availability statement, small grey sub-line with the URL underneath
structure.motion: statement at f253; sub-line fades in 10 fr after the last word; holds 82 fr; fades out at f335

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg, muted, accent, bg, mono for the eyebrow and URL
params.content.eyebrow: uppercase label before the name, e.g. 'Introducing' ('' = none)
params.content.name: product name as a statement, with its period
params.content.claims: 1-3 short claims, one idea each, ending in a period
params.content.sub: small line under the close; defaults to brand.url
params.content.accentWords: words of the close painted in the brand accent
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; layout recomposes, type caps at 10 % of width
params.timing.period: frames at 30 fps between statements (default 78 = 2.6 s), scaled to fps
params.timing.bpm: cut on 4/4 bars at this tempo instead (92 BPM ~ 2.6 s)
params.timing.firstExtra: extra frames on the first statement for the eyebrow (default 11)
params.glow: soft accent glow behind the type, 0 = flat (default)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured at 30 fps on the reference: per-word entrance (not whole-line), stagger 2 fr; contrast curve 0.30, 0.53, 0.70, 0.83, 0.89, 0.94, 0.96, 0.98 (outExpo ~12 fr); 4 empty frames between statements; exit 5 fr is shorter than the entrance. The scale creep never stops, so no frame is static. Keep every statement to one line at 16:9.
